general_country_allow.summary: The countries customers may register and order from.
general_country_allow.usage: The set of countries offered in address country dropdowns across the store.

general_country_default.summary: The country selected by default on address forms.
general_country_default.usage: The pre-selected country for new addresses and the default used when guessing a visitor's region.

general_country_destinations.summary: Countries shown at the top of country dropdowns.
general_country_destinations.usage: Priority countries listed first, above a separator, in country selectors for quicker selection.

general_country_eu_countries.summary: Which countries are treated as part of the EU.
general_country_eu_countries.usage: The countries Magento considers EU members, used for VAT and tax rules.

general_country_optional_zip_countries.summary: Countries where the postal code is optional.
general_country_optional_zip_countries.usage: Countries for which a ZIP / postal code is not required on address forms.

general_locale_code.usage: The locale that sets the storefront language along with date and number formats.

general_locale_firstday.summary: The first day of the week in calendars.
general_locale_firstday.usage: Which day date pickers and calendars start the week on.

general_locale_timezone.usage: The time zone used for order timestamps, reports and scheduled (cron) tasks.

general_locale_weekend.summary: Which days count as the weekend.
general_locale_weekend.usage: The days treated as the weekend in sales reports and statistics.

general_locale_weight_unit.summary: The unit used for product weights.
general_locale_weight_unit.usage: Whether product weights are expressed in pounds or kilograms.

general_region_display_all.summary: Show the state/region field for all countries.
general_region_display_all.usage: When Yes, the state/region selector is shown even for countries that have no predefined region list.

general_region_state_required.summary: Countries where a state/region is mandatory.
general_region_state_required.usage: The countries for which customers must provide a state or region on address forms.

general_single_store_mode_enabled.summary: Hide multi-store controls for a single-store setup.
general_single_store_mode_enabled.usage: When Yes, store and website scope switchers are hidden to simplify the admin. Ignored if the installation has more than one store.

general_store_information_name.usage: The business name shown on invoices, emails and other documents.

general_store_information_phone.usage: The phone number shown to customers and on documents.

general_store_information_hours.usage: Business hours shown to customers wherever store information is displayed.

general_store_information_country_id.summary: The country your business is located in.
general_store_information_country_id.usage: Your business country, shown on documents and used in some tax and VAT logic.

general_store_information_region_id.summary: The state or region your business is in.

general_store_information_postcode.usage: The postal code of your business address, shown on documents.

general_store_information_city.usage: The city of your business address, shown on documents.

general_store_information_street_line1.usage: The first line of your business street address, shown on documents.

general_store_information_street_line2.usage: An optional second line for your business street address.

general_store_information_merchant_vat_n.usage: The merchant VAT number shown on documents and used for EU VAT validation.

general_store_information_validate_vat_n.summary: Check your VAT number against the EU service.
general_store_information_validate_vat_n.usage: Validates the merchant VAT number entered above against the EU VIES service.
